lines.speaker: Lettie
lines.text: You can see the whole kingdom from Cannon Ridge! Mind the cannons: the barrel glows and puffs before it fires, so jump when it shakes.

lines.speaker: Lettie
lines.text: Hop on the spring pad at the north edge to reach the Sky Rows. They lead all the way to the Flagpole Fort!

lines.speaker: Lettie
lines.text: Funny thing: from up here I can see bubbles coming up from the bottom of the moat, in the north-west corner.
